story_title: As an authorised internal user, I want to view venue availability over relevant dates and times so that I can identify when venues may be requested

acceptance_criteria.text: Users can select a venue and date/time period.
Availability is shown per fixed slot (AM, PM, Night) for each day, including slots occupied by setup or turnaround time.
Only authorised internal users can access the availability calendar.

test_cases.title: Open a venue's availability and read the grid
test_cases.preconditions:
Demo data seeded 2026-09-26 — the dates below move with the seed, because prisma/seed.ts builds them as today + n days (see DOCUMENTATION.md, Known Gaps).
Logged in as Venue Staff: marcus.wong@connectsphere.com / password123
steps: Click 'Venues' in the sidebar
On the 'Marina Grand Hall' row, click 'View availability'
Read the range the page opens with, and the three column headings
Set 'From' to 7 Dec 2026 and 'To' to 13 Dec 2026
Click 'Show availability'
Choose 'Jurong Expo Floor' from the 'Venue' picker
Click 'Show availability'
test_cases.test_data:
Venue: Marina Grand Hall (MAR-GH), then Jurong Expo Floor (JUR-EXP)
From: 7 Dec 2026
To: 13 Dec 2026
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Marina Grand Hall availability' page opens on a week from today (Singapore time): seven day rows, with 'From' and 'To' already filled in with those two dates. The grid has exactly three columns, in this order, each showing its times: AM 07:00–12:00, PM 13:00–18:00, Night 19:00–24:00. After 'Show availability' the grid shows exactly seven day rows, 7 Dec 2026 to 13 Dec 2026 (the 7 Dec row is not empty — it carries the Straits Medical Research Symposium booking). Choosing Jurong Expo Floor changes the title to 'Jurong Expo Floor availability', keeps the range at 7–13 Dec 2026, and shows the same three columns.

test_cases.title: A Night event's setup takes the whole PM slot, and its turnaround the next day's AM
test_cases.preconditions:
Demo data seeded 2026-09-26 — the dates below move with the seed, because prisma/seed.ts builds them as today + n days (see DOCUMENTATION.md, Known Gaps).
One-North Auditorium (ONE-AUD) records setup and teardown time, and has an approved booking, 'Bayu Energy Transition Panel', 18:00–21:00 on 9 Nov 2026.
Logged in as Venue Staff: marcus.wong@connectsphere.com / password123
steps: Open the availability page for One-North Auditorium
Set 'From' to 9 Nov 2026 and 'To' to 10 Nov 2026
Click 'Show availability'
test_cases.test_data:
Venue: One-North Auditorium (ONE-AUD)
From: 9 Nov 2026
To: 10 Nov 2026
test_cases.expected_result: On 9 Nov 2026: AM shows 'Free'. PM shows 'Turnaround' — the whole slot before the event is taken for setup. Night shows 'Booked' with 'Bayu Energy Transition Panel'. On 10 Nov 2026: AM shows 'Turnaround' — the turnaround runs into the NEXT DAY, because Night is the last slot of its own day; PM and Night show 'Free'. Under 'Approved bookings' the booking shows 18:00–21:00 with 'Room in use' running from 9 Nov 2026, 13:00 to 10 Nov 2026, 12:00 — whole slots, not the recorded minutes.

test_cases.test_data:
Venue: Jurong Expo Floor (JUR-EXP)
From: 29 Nov 2026
To: 30 Nov 2026
test_cases.expected_result: On 29 Nov 2026: AM and PM show 'Free', and Night shows 'Turnaround' — the event is in the morning, so the slot before it is the PREVIOUS DAY'S Night. Under 'Approved bookings', 'Room in use' runs from 29 Nov 2026, 19:00 to 1 Dec 2026, 00:00.

test_cases.title: Two overlapping unavailable periods are identified as overlapping

Jurong Expo Floor (JUR-EXP) has TWO unavailable periods that overlap each other: 'Loading bay hoist inspection.' (maintenance) 5–9 Nov 2026, and 'Fire suppression system recertification.' Logged in as Venue Staff: marcus.wong@connectsphere.com / password123
steps: Open the availability page for Jurong Expo Floor
Set 'From' to 5 Nov 2026 and 'To' to 11 Nov 2026
Click 'Show availability'
Read the 'Unavailable periods' list
test_cases.test_data:
Venue: Jurong Expo Floor (JUR-EXP)
From: 5 Nov 2026
To: 11 Nov 2026
test_cases.expected_result: A warning 'Some bookings or unavailable periods overlap' is shown above the grid. test_cases.title: An approved booking blocks its slots, and is listed, even while its event is still in planning
test_cases.preconditions:
Demo data seeded 2026-09-26 — the dates below move with the seed, because prisma/seed.ts builds them as today + n days (see DOCUMENTATION.md, Known Gaps).
Marina Grand Hall (MAR-GH) has an APPROVED booking, 'Straits Medical Research Symposium', 09:00–18:00 on 7 Dec 2026, whose EVENT is still in Planning — not Confirmed. The venue has a 180-minute setup and 120-minute teardown.
Logged in as Event Coordinator: daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123
steps: Open the availability page for Marina Grand Hall
Set 'From' to 6 Dec 2026 and 'To' to 7 Dec 2026
Click 'Show availability'
Read the booking under 'Approved bookings'
test_cases.test_data:
Venue: Marina Grand Hall (MAR-GH)
From: 6 Dec 2026
To: 7 Dec 2026
test_cases.expected_result: On 7 Dec 2026 AM and PM show 'Booked' with 'Straits Medical Research Symposium' — NOT 'Free' — and Night shows 'Turnaround'. On 6 Dec 2026 Night shows 'Turnaround' too, for the setup slot before the event. Under 'Approved bookings' the booking is listed with the event status 'Planning', 7 Dec 2026, 09:00–18:00, layout 'Theatre', and 'Room in use' from 6 Dec 2026, 19:00 to 8 Dec 2026, 00:00. The room must not read as free: an approved booking already commits it, however far its event has got.

Changi Conference Centre (CBP-CONF) has a PENDING booking request, 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference', on 14 Dec 2026 and no approved booking that day. Logged in as Event Coordinator: daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123
steps: Open the availability page for Changi Conference Centre for 14 Dec 2026
Choose Marina Auditorium from the 'Venue' picker and show 1 Nov 2026
